sentence: This project studies how explainable artificial intelligence can give early feedback about failures in chip design.
This project builds computational tools that link brain imaging and genetic data to study the human brain.
This project studies how proteins that sense warming, changing pH and oxidation evolved in three species of Arctic and sub-Arctic fish.
This project studies how the local surface structure and nanoscale environment control the chemical reactivity of individual molecules.
This project builds a tool that measures how glioblastoma cells release a neurotransmitter.
This project builds a skin patch with a micropump that is driven by human movement.
This project studies whether middle school engineering courses are equally effective across different demographic groups and school environments.
This project builds nanoscale tools that identify the amino acids of a protein at the single molecule level.
This project develops faster and more reliable methods for sampling from models with enormous numbers of variables.
This project studies how sentence structure and conversational context work together, using eye gaze data.
This project studies how submarine groundwater discharge adds to nutrient transport and oxygen deficiency in coastal systems.
This project uses a single crystal X-ray diffractometer to measure the three-dimensional structure of molecules.
This project builds simulation tools that show how nuclei move in molecules with strong quantum effects.
This project builds a tool that searches for deep learning algorithms and their hardware accelerators at the same time.
This project builds a deep learning framework that uses physics to design nanoscale structures that control light.
This project builds tools that use symbolic artificial intelligence to discover constitutive laws of soft functional composites.
This project designs and builds a small precision stage for accurate chiplet placement in hybrid bonding.
This project builds robots that move along virtual roads created from an architectural drawing or satellite imagery.
